title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Avery Kim
description: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples, and update the docs site to surface them. Motivation: provide runnable examples for customers evaluating agents+tool-calling with Redwood's streaming and structured output features, reduce onboarding friction for RAG patterns, and standardize templates used by internal demos and the examples repo. Changes include: 1) new quickstart tutorials for Python and TypeScript showing RAG pipelines with vector stores, prefix caching, and tool calling; 2) example agent that demonstrates tool registration, function schemas, and safe fallbacks when tools error; 3) updated docs navigation and examples index pages; 4) smoke examples in redwood-examples to be used by CI. Checklist: - [x] Python quickstart (redwood-sdk-python/examples/rag-agent-quickstart) - [x] TypeScript quickstart (redwood-sdk-typescript/examples/rag-agent-quickstart) - [x] Agent tool-calling sample (redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling) - [x] Docs site integration and sidebar updates (redwood-docs/site/content/examples) - [x] Unit/integration tests for example scripts - [x] CI job to smoke-run examples on build - [x] Documented common failures and troubleshooting notes Related work: ENG-4123 (agent onboarding), DOC-221 (examples index refactor).
commits: feat(docs): add rag agent quickstart python and ts
feat(examples): add tool-calling agent sample with mocked tools
docs(site): wire examples into sidebar and add TOC entries
test(ci): add smoke job to run quickstarts in CI
chore: tidy example README and add troubleshooting section
review_comments: Jordan Lee (2026-02-21): Left a few nits in the TS quickstart about await/async usage and suggested adding a small diagram explaining request routing; PTAL.
Avery Kim (2026-02-22): Addressed async nits and added a short diagram SVG to the docs. Also added a note about using prefix caching with long-lived chat conversations.

Priya Nair (2026-02-23): Can we add a short section on failure modes when the vector store is unavailable? Suggested a fallback to a smaller context retrieval and a clear error message. Marcus to weigh in on API ergonomics.
Marcus Green (2026-02-24): Approved after we added the fallback section and clarified the function schema examples for tool-calling. CI flaked once (network timeout) but passed on re-run.
ci_checks: examples-smoke (workflow): pass (re-run after transient network failure)
release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts (Python & TypeScript) and a tool-calling agent example. Docs site now surfaces RAG agent tutorials and troubleshooting. CI runs smoke tests for examples.
notes_for_operators: The examples-smoke CI job runs lightweight end-to-end scenarios against mocked vector stores and tools. If flakes appear in CI, re-run the examples-smoke workflow; investigate transient network failures and increase timeout for the smoke job if failures persist.
